verdict.rationale: Unit's docs say developers can create deposit and wallet accounts held in FBO structures at partner banks, and that APIs expose customer, account and compliance data. That covers the core of opening deposit accounts programmatically. Nothing in the pack documents FDIC insurance, an end-to-end application-to-active flow (KYC/onboarding), or a sandbox environment, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: explicit evidence the accounts are insured, a documented programmatic application/KYC-to-active-account flow, sandbox environment with production parity, independent or hands-on corroboration.
